episodes.synopsis: Lightning strikes the fort, and Ronja is born.
episodes.title: Born in the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Ronja grows to be a lively ten-year-old and is given permission to go into the forest.
episodes.title: First Trip to the Forest

episodes.synopsis: During her first visit to the forest, Ronja takes in new sights and faces danger.
episodes.title: Fear in the Forest

episodes.synopsis: While practising not being frightened, Ronja is chased. Later, at Hell's Gap, she sees something unexpected.
episodes.title: Hearing the Whistler

episodes.synopsis: Ronja learns that Birk is the son of Borka, her father's longtime adversary.
episodes.title: Enemy in the Fort

episodes.synopsis: Mattis and his robbers challenge Borka and his robbers at Hell's Gap. Ronja learns more about her father.
episodes.title: Taking Without Asking

episodes.synopsis: Whilst walking through the forest in a thick fog, Ronja is tempted by a sweet, dangerous song.
episodes.title: Song In the Mist

episodes.synopsis: Mattis tries to drive Borka from the fort while Ronja wonders why she hasn't seen Birk all autumn.
episodes.title: Autumn Deepens

episodes.synopsis: While out practising skiing, Ronja takes a tumble.
episodes.title: Stuck in the Snow

episodes.synopsis: Ronja struggles to free herself before heavy snowfall comes.
episodes.title: The Vow to be Brother and Sister

episodes.synopsis: Ronja falls ill and can't help but worry about Birk.
episodes.title: To Be Done in Secret

episodes.synopsis: Determined to see Birk, Ronja works hard to try and clear the rubble that's plugged an underground passage.
episodes.title: The Whistler Underground

episodes.synopsis: Lovis orders all the robbers to wash their dirty bodies in the snow.
episodes.title: Wretched Robbers

episodes.synopsis: Spring returns to the forest, and Ronja and Birk meet two wild horses.
episodes.title: Splendid Spring

episodes.synopsis: The conflict between Mattis and Borka intensifies, and Ronja faces a horrible sight.
episodes.title: Endless Fighting (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ronja decides upon a daring act that will change everything.
episodes.title: Endless Fighting (2)

episodes.synopsis: Ronja returns to the forest and makes a bold decision.
episodes.title: Moving Out

episodes.synopsis: Ronja and Birk hear something moving around inside the cave.
episodes.title: Something in the Cave

episodes.synopsis: Ronja and Birk have a big argument, sending Ronja from the cave in tears.
episodes.title: The Lost Knife

episodes.synopsis: Ronja and Birk tend to a wounded mare, and try to tame Villain and Savage.
episodes.title: With the Wild Horses

episodes.synopsis: Ronja and Birk encounter the Great Harpy as they drift towards Greedy Falls.
episodes.title: Hunted by Harpies

episodes.synopsis: Ronja and Birk are startled by a visitor.
episodes.title: Only This Summer

episodes.synopsis: As autumn approaches, Birk is surprised by an unexpected offer.
episodes.title: Life isn't to be Thrown Away

episodes.synopsis: With the forest swarming with the sheriff's soldiers, Noddle-Pete offers a plan, but Ronja has an idea of her own.
episodes.title: Fight of the Wild Beasts

episodes.synopsis: A Leader is chosen.
episodes.title: One Band of Robbers

episodes.synopsis: The robbers return to robbing, and Noddle-Pete tells Ronja a fascinating secret.
episodes.title: The Call of Spring
